scientific_integrity: Analytic Fourier/convexity proof covers all integer m>=4 and all feasible real floors; the included exact small-size checker supplements, rather than establishes, the infinite-parameter claim. Novelty is assessed only against inspected literature. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes SLEM only for finite symmetric stochastic chains on C_m square K_2 with uniform stationary distribution and pointwise floors on all rim and rung transitions. No assertion about all optimizers, nonuniform stationary laws, nonreversible chains, or finite-time mixing.
title: Five-facet fastest mixing on circular ladders with two mandatory edge flows
